# Demo media

`horizon-boulevard.webp` is original SYNC / HORIZON placeholder artwork generated for this resource and prepared at 3840×2160. The default uses the static image without zoom or loop motion for maximum sharpness and stability. Replace it with licensed server footage or artwork using the paths in `config.lua`.

Recommended production video: 1920×1080 WebM or MP4, 30 FPS, without an audio track. Keep important subjects in the configured focal region.
